full_text_zh:
[P1] 团圆
余丽琼 / 文
朱成梁 / 图

tuán yuán
团圆

明天出版社

[P2] 爸爸在外面盖大房子。
他每年只回家一次，那就是过年。
今天，我和妈妈起得特别早

[P3] 爸爸回家了。

[P4] 我远远地看着他，不肯走近。
爸爸走过来，一把抱起我，用胡子扎我的脸。
“妈妈……”我吓得大哭起来。
“看我给你买了什么！”爸爸赶紧去掏他的大皮箱——
哦，好漂亮的帽子！
妈妈也换上了爸爸买的新棉袄。

[P5] 吃过中饭，爸爸对我说：‘走，剪头去。剪了头，明年就会顺顺当当的。’
我坐在椅子上等爸爸。呀，镜子里的爸爸越来越像以前的爸爸了！

[P7] 包汤圆喽！爸爸把一枚硬币包进汤圆里：“谁吃到它，谁就会交好运喔！
这天夜里，爆竹“噼噼啪啪”地响个不停，我依偎在爸爸妈妈中间睡着了，迷迷糊糊地，我听见爸爸妈妈在轻轻地说着话，他们说啊说啊……

[P8] 第二天一大早，妈妈就端上了热腾腾的汤圆，爸爸用勺子喂给我吃。
突然，我的牙被一个硬东西硌了一下。
“好运硬币！好运硬币！”我叫起来。
“毛毛真棒！快收到兜里，好运就不会跑掉喽！”爸爸比我还开心呢。
妈妈给我换上了新棉袄，要去拜年啦！

[P9] 路上，我遇到了大春。
“毛毛，你去哪儿啊？”
“我跟爸爸去拜年！”
“我也是，看，我有大红包！”
“这有什么稀奇！”我从兜里掏出那枚硬币，“我有好运硬币！爸爸包在汤圆里的，给我吃到了！”

[P10] 大年初二，天阴沉沉的，要下雪了，一大早，爸爸就忙了起来，补窗户缝、刷新门漆、换新灯泡……
呀，家里一下子变得亮堂了。
“走，补屋顶去喽！”爸爸冲我努了努嘴。
太好了，那儿是妈妈从不准我一个人上去的地方呢。

[P11] 哈，我看见了大春家的屋顶。
“咦，那边是什么声音啊？”
“噢，大街上在舞龙灯呢！”爸爸直起身子，看了看远处。
“在哪儿在哪儿？”我使劲儿踮起脚尖。
爸爸让我骑到了他的肩膀上：“这回看到了吧？”
“看到了看到了，他们过来啦！”

[P13] 大年初三，下雪了，下得好大好大！
下午，雪终于停了，大春他们来找我玩。
我们在院子里堆了一个大雪人，然后开始打雪仗。

[P14] 天快黑的时候，我才回到家，一摸口袋——啊，不见了！
好运硬币不见了！
我冲到院子里，院子里全是雪，我的好运硬币在哪儿？

[P15] “毛毛别笑，我再给你一个，看，跟那个一样！”爸爸摸出一枚硬币。
“不要不要，我就要那个！”我一边哭一边叫。
晚上，我难过地爬上床，脱棉袄的时候——“丁当”，有个东西掉到了地上。
硬币！我的好运硬币！
“爸爸快来看，好运没丢，它一直在我身上！”
Ding Dang

[P16] 那天夜里，我睡得特别香……
早上一起来，我就看见妈妈在为爸爸收拾东西——
爸爸今天要走了。

[P17] 爸爸很快就收拾好了，他走到我身边，蹲下来用力抱住我。他在耳边轻轻地说：“下次回来，爸爸给你带一个洋娃娃，好不好？”
“不！”我拼命地摇头，“我要把这个给你……”

[P18] 我把那枚攥了很久的暖暖的硬币放到爸爸的手心里：
“这个给你，下次回来，我们还把它包在汤圆里呢。”
爸爸没说话，他用力地点点头，接着我不松手……

[P20] 团聚、分别，再团聚、再分别……大大小小的团聚
和分别构成了我们的人生。
—— 朱成梁
full_text_en:
[P1] Reunion
Yu Lijiong / Text
Zhu Chengliang / Illustrations

tuán yuán
Reunion

Tomorrow Publishing House

[P2] Dad is building big houses outside.
He only comes home once a year, and that's during the New Year.
Today, my mom and I got up especially early.

[P3] Dad is home.

[P4] I watched him from afar, unwilling to get close.
Dad walked over, picked me up, and tickled my face with his beard.
"Mommy..." I cried out in fear.
"Look what I bought for you!" Dad hurried to open his big suitcase—
Oh, such a beautiful hat!
Mom also put on the new cotton-padded jacket Dad bought.

[P5] After lunch, Dad said to me, 'Come on, let's get a haircut. After this, next year will be smooth sailing.'
I sat on the chair waiting for Dad. Wow, Dad in the mirror was starting to look more and more like the Dad from before!

[P7] Let's make tangyuan! Dad puts a coin into one of the dumplings: "Whoever eats it will have good luck!"
That night, firecrackers crackled "papapapa" nonstop. I nestled between Mom and Dad and fell asleep, half-dreaming. I heard Mom and Dad whispering softly... they kept talking and talking...

[P8] Early the next morning, Mom brought out steaming hot tangyuan, and Dad fed me with a spoon.
Suddenly, my tooth hit something hard.
"Lucky coin! Lucky coin!" I shouted.
"Mao Mao, you're amazing! Quickly put it in your pocket, so the good luck won't run away!" Dad was even happier than me.
Mom helped me put on my new cotton-padded jacket. It was time to go visit relatives!

[P9] On the way, I met Dachun.
"Mao Mao, where are you going?"
"I'm going to pay New Year visits with my dad!"
"Me too, look, I have a big red envelope!"
"What's so special about that!" I pulled out the coin from my pocket, "I have a lucky coin! Dad put it in the tangyuan, and I got it!"

[P10] On the second day of the Lunar New Year, the sky was gloomy and it was about to snow. Early in the morning, Dad got busy, sealing window cracks, repainting the door, and replacing light bulbs...
Wow, the house suddenly became bright and cheerful.
"Come on, let's go fix the roof!" Dad nudged me with his eyes.
Great! That's a place Mom never allowed me to go alone.

[P11] Ha, I saw the roof of Dachun's house.
"Huh, what's that sound over there?"
"Oh, they're dancing the dragon lanterns in the street!" Dad straightened up and looked into the distance.
"Where? Where?" I stretched up on my tiptoes.
Dad lifted me onto his shoulders: "Can you see now?"
"I see it, I see it, they're coming!"

[P13] On the third day of the Lunar New Year, it snowed, and it snowed so hard!
In the afternoon, the snow finally stopped, and Da Chun and the others came to play with me.
We built a big snowman in the yard, and then started having a snowball fight.

[P14] It was almost dark when I got home. I reached into my pocket—oh no, it's gone!
My lucky coin is gone!
I rushed to the yard. The yard is full of snow. Where is my lucky coin?

[P15] "Mao Mao, don't laugh, I'll give you another one, look, just like that one!" Dad took out a coin.
"No, no, I want that one!" I cried and shouted.
In the evening, I climbed sadly onto the bed, and when I took off my cotton jacket — "Ding dang", something fell to the ground.
A coin! My lucky coin!
"Dad, come quick, the luck hasn't been lost, it's been with me all along!"
Ding Dang

[P16] That night, I slept especially soundly...
When I woke up in the morning, I saw Mom packing things for Dad—
Dad is leaving today.

[P17] Dad quickly finished packing. He walked over to me, knelt down, and hugged me tightly. He whispered in my ear, "When I come back next time, Dad will bring you a doll. Okay?"
"No!" I shook my head fiercely. "I want to give this to you..."

[P18] I placed the warm coin, which I had held tightly for a long time, into my father's palm:
"Here you go. Next time you come back, we'll still wrap it in tangyuan." 
Dad didn't say anything. He nodded firmly, and then I wouldn't let go...

[P20] Gathering, parting, gathering again, parting again... big and small gatherings and partings make up our lives.
— Zhu Chengliang
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《团圆》的封面，画面中一家三口在床榻上相拥而眠，背景悬挂着写有“团圆”的红色灯笼，右侧标注拼音与汉字“团圆”，下方为出版社名称。
[P2] 本页文字说明爸爸常年在外工作，每年只在过年时回家一次，今天是过年，因此‘我’和妈妈起得很早。画面中，妈妈正在梳妆台前梳头，小女孩站在一旁注视着妈妈。
[P3] 爸爸拖着行李箱回家，小女孩在门口迎接，画面充满节日气氛，街道两旁挂满红灯笼，河中有鸭子游动，远处有摊贩和行人。
[P4] 爸爸回家后，小女孩因陌生而害怕，爸爸用胡子扎她，她大哭起来。爸爸从行李箱拿出新买的帽子，妈妈也换上了新棉袄，一家人开始享受团圆的时光。
[P5] 爸爸带小女孩去理发店剪头发，他告诉女儿剪了头明年会顺顺当当，小女孩在椅子上等待，发现镜子里的爸爸越来越像以前的爸爸了。
[P6] 画面描绘了夜晚的小镇街景，房屋挂满红灯笼，河上倒映着灯光，一家三口站在门前，小女孩穿着红色衣服，爸爸背着行李箱，妈妈站在一旁，门前有小狗，远处可见拱桥和树木，整体氛围温馨而喜庆。
[P7] 爸爸将一枚硬币包进汤圆中，寓意谁吃到谁有好运；夜晚，一家人依偎着入睡，孩子迷迷糊糊中听见父母轻声交谈，画面温馨宁静。
[P8] 第二天一早，一家人吃汤圆，小女孩咬到硬币，爸爸和她都很开心，妈妈为她换上新棉袄准备去拜年。
[P9] 小女孩在街上遇到朋友大春，两人互相分享拜年计划和各自的幸运物，小女孩兴奋地展示自己从汤圆里吃到的硬币。
[P10] 大年初二，爸爸忙着修补房屋，小女孩兴奋地参与其中，爸爸带她去补屋顶，那是妈妈从不允许她独自上去的地方。
[P11] 小女孩和爸爸站在屋顶上，她指着远处，爸爸将她扛在肩上，两人一起观看街上舞龙灯的热闹景象。
[P12] 画面描绘了小镇街景中热闹的舞龙灯场景，一条色彩鲜艳的龙灯在石桥上穿行，周围人群围观欢呼，房屋挂满红灯笼，河上倒映灯光，气氛喜庆热烈。
[P13] 大年初三下大雪，雪停后小女孩和朋友们在院子里堆雪人、打雪仗，画面充满童趣和欢乐。
[P14] 小女孩回家后发现装有好运硬币的口袋空了，她焦急地冲到雪地院子里寻找硬币。
[P15] 小女孩发现装有好运硬币的口袋空了，她难过地爬上床，脱棉袄时硬币掉在地上，她惊喜地发现硬币还在自己身上，并叫爸爸来看。
[P16] 小女孩在睡梦中度过一夜，醒来后发现妈妈正在为即将离开的爸爸收拾行李，暗示爸爸将要外出，画面温馨而略带离别的氛围。
[P17] 爸爸收拾好行李后拥抱女儿，承诺下次回来带洋娃娃给她，女儿却摇头表示要将自己珍视的东西送给爸爸。
[P18] 小女孩将珍藏的硬币交给即将离开的爸爸，并承诺下次再一起包在汤圆里，爸爸默默点头，女儿紧紧握住他的手，画面充满依依不舍的温情。
[P19] 画面中，小女孩和妈妈手牵手站在山坡上，眺望远处驶来的蓝色巴士，背景是木栅栏和蓝天白云，暗示爸爸即将乘巴士离开，氛围中带着离别的不舍与期待。
[P20] 画面展示了一张家庭照片、安全帽、对讲机等物品，配文表达了人生中团聚与分别的循环，点明主题，情感深沉。
